summary: Wellness Workshops, a local health education initiative, is launching a seminar series called "Preventative Health: Screenings and Check-Ups for Lifelong Wellness" starting September 10, 2023. Expert-led sessions cover early detection, health screenings, the psychology of preventative behavior, customized strategies by demographic, youth health habits, and integrating mental and physical care. The workshops are free to attend and aim to foster a proactive approach to health in the community.
one_line: Wellness Workshops announces a free fall 2023 seminar series on preventative health screenings, check-ups, and the psychology and customization of preventative care.
key_facts: Wellness Workshops is a locally recognized health education initiative whose preventative health seminar series starts on September 10, 2023.
The series is titled "Preventative Health: Screenings and Check-Ups for Lifelong Wellness" and is free to attend.
Dr. Angela Pearson, a public health specialist, gives "The Looming Epidemics: Curbing the Tide with Preventative Care" on September 15, 2023.

Dr. Ravi Gupta, a prominent cardiologist, presents "Decoding Health Screenings: From Cholesterol to Colonoscopies" on September 20, 2023, covering mammograms, pap smears, bone density tests, and cholesterol checks.
Dr. Gupta aims to debunk myths about procedures such as colonoscopies and highlight technology that makes screenings more comfortable and less invasive.
Dr. Hannah Stein, a behavioral psychologist, leads "Mind Matters: The Psychology of Preventative Actions" on October 1, 2023, discussing fear, denial, and optimism bias.

Dr. Marcus Liang leads "Tailored for Life: Customizing Preventative Health" on October 5, 2023, addressing how age, gender, genetics, and lifestyle require customized strategies and targeted screenings for minority populations.
Sarah Johnson, a pediatric health consultant, gives "Young Guardians: Fostering a Preventative Ethos in Youth" on October 12, 2023, covering pediatric check-ups, immunizations, and health literacy.
Dr. Emily Briggs, an expert in integrative medicine, presents "Holistic Horizons: Integrating Mind and Body in Preventative Care" on October 20, 2023, the penultimate session.
Workshops will address early detection of conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and various forms of cancer.
